author: NorthEast News Desk
body: A 22-year-old man from Foster died after his motorcycle collided with a tow truck on Tunk Hill Road in Scituate late Friday, police said. The crash occurred at about 10 p.m. and closed the road while emergency crews and investigators worked at the scene.

According to a witness account relayed by police, the motorcycle was traveling west when a tow truck began leaving a driveway with its emergency lights activated. The rider was unable to stop before striking the truck. He was pronounced dead at the scene. Authorities had not released his name as of Saturday morning.

The tow-truck operator was taken to a hospital for treatment. Police said their preliminary investigation indicates speed may have contributed to the collision, but no final determination has been announced. The investigation remains active. The new details identify the fatal outcome of the police response that drew a large presence to Tunk Hill Road Friday night.
dek: Police said the motorcycle collided with a tow truck exiting a driveway on Tunk Hill Road late Friday night.
headline: Foster motorcyclist, 22, killed in Scituate crash
